name: seamtrail
description: SeamTrail, your team's shared memory, in Codex: each chat asks once which SeamTrail project it is for, then gets that project's context, the news that touches its own work, and at every message the latest memory about the tickets you name — from the agent's short summary of the chat's work and the ticket numbers in it, never the conversation — saves only into it, and is reminded at turn end to save what was decided.

interface.shortDescription: Your team's shared project memory: decisions and why, drift, blockers, tickets.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to SeamTrail (mcp.seamtrail.com) with your SeamTrail token. At chat start the chat gets its project's context; at each message, what is new on its work; at turn end, one reminder to save what was decided, learned or blocked. Needs SEAMTRAIL_TOKEN in your environment and its hooks trusted once in /hooks.
